capabilities: Add a Kanban view to a base
Group notes into columns by a list-type property
Display filtered notes from a base as cards
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A plugin that adds a Kanban Board view for Bases, grouping a base's filtered notes into columns
problem: Bases in Obsidian have no built-in Kanban board view, so notes managed by a base can only be browsed as lists or tables.
summary: Kanban board view for Obsidian Bases that groups a base's filtered notes into columns by a chosen list-type property.
